rules: Install the HyperFrames agent skills before writing a composition: `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes`, or in Claude Code `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` then `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`.
A composition is an HTML file whose root element has data-composition-id, data-width, data-height and data-duration. Timed elements use class="clip" with data-start and data-duration.
Register one paused GSAP root timeline per composition on window.__timelines["<composition-id>"]. The runtime seeks it frame by frame, so never play it yourself.
Rendering is deterministic: no Date.now(), no unseeded Math.random(), no network fetches at render time.
Check before rendering: `npx hyperframes lint`, `npx hyperframes check`, and `npx hyperframes snapshot --at 1,3,5` for frames. Make the MP4 with `npx hyperframes render --output video.mp4`.
